newsitem.title: USA: Rutherford-Moran gets $150 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Rutherford-Moran gets $150 mln credit line.

text.p: Rutherford-Moran Oil Corp said on Tuesday it completed a new $150 million three-year revolving credit facility, in order to develop a concession in the Gulf of Thailand.
Rutherford said in a statement the credit line had been arranged by Chase Securities and that Chase Manhattan Bank was the agent.

"The new bank facility will give Rutherford-Moran the ability to successfully continue to develop and exploit opportunities in our Block B8/32 concession in the Gulf of Thailand," said David Chavenson, vice president of finance and chief financial officer.
